In-flight work is bounded by maxInFlight: the loop only requests the remaining capacity and waits on Promise.race when full. Transient failures extend visibility with capped exponential backoff, permanent or exhausted ones go to the DLQ, and the original is acked only after the DLQ send succeeds. stop() ends polling, then waits for in-flight handlers before returning.
